note: Prices are expressed in US dollars, so they are inflation-adjusted but do not account for price differences across countries.
title: Carbon price vs. share of global CO₂ emissions covered
subtitle: Carbon prices, measured in US$ per tonne of CO₂ on emissions covered by a tax or trading scheme versus the share of global CO₂ emissions covered. These prices can be economy-wide or sector-specific.
